newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer, buying for barges supportive.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer, buying for barges supportive.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were slightly firmer in line with crude and NYMEX unleaded futures and with some light buying interest for barges supportive, traders said.

"Some people are expecting gasoline to make a move higher and this has created some pockets of buying interest," one trader said. "There hasn't been much buying from Germany recently so they may come in again soon but there's plenty of oil around," he added.
Traders said the trans-Atlantic arbitrage window appeared nearly ready to reopen but today's NWE gains could put this off for a while.
Some saw a gap of around $3 a tonne but others said an increase in New York gasoline prices of about 0.50 cent a gallon or decrease in prices in Europe of the same level could restart the market.
In the ARA barge market trade house buying supported Eurograde barges with trade reported at $182.50 and $183 a tonne fob ARA.
Cargo prices were steady with Eurograde cargoes valued around $188 a tonne cif NWE.
